'''Zord's Atmosphere Baths''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Formos/Legends|Formos]].

==Description==
The Atmosphere Baths was a spa on Formos where visitors could relax in a steam bath. Visitors of many [[Species/Legends|species]] came to the spa, including [[N'Mrith]], who appreciated the steam bath, as it reminded him of his home.

==History==
When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the world on a smuggling run, their contact, N'Mrith, advised them to meet him at the location, as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops were patrolling the streets, looking out for suspicious behavior.
The two smugglers met N'Mrith as planned, but did not enjoy the therapeutic conditions in the spa.
